title: OpenAI for Startups & Accelerator Grants: Up to $25,000 Direct API Credits

beats.text: Stop paying for GPT-4o! You can secure up to $25,000 in free OpenAI API credits right now. Let’s get you that compute power.
beats.visual_focus: Total dollar value hero card with OpenAI branding.

beats.text: This isn't just theory. You get direct API access to GPT-4o, o1, and embeddings. If you're bootstrapped, leverage Microsoft Founders Hub for an additional $150,000 in Azure credits.
beats.visual_focus: Split screen showing API dashboard and Azure credits badge.

beats.text: Qualification is simple: You must be pre-seed to Series A, have a live product or working prototype, and use a professional company-domain email address. No side projects allowed.
Apply through your affiliated VC or accelerator partner link. No partner? Head to startups.microsoft.com, sign in with your GitHub, and fill out the brief founder application.
beats.visual_focus: Screen recording of the Microsoft Founders Hub portal.

beats.text: Founders on Twitter are reporting approval turnarounds of just 24 to 48 hours. The system is fast, but the funding pools have strict caps.
beats.visual_focus: Fast-scrolling tweets or Reddit comments showcasing approvals.

perk_metadata.headline: OpenAI for Startups & Accelerator Grants: Up to $25,000 Direct API Credits
perk_metadata.benefit_summary: Up to $25,000 in direct OpenAI API credits (for GPT-4o, o1, and embeddings) plus technical office hours via approved partner incubators; self-serve startups access OpenAI models via Microsoft Founders Hub (up to $150,000 in Azure credits)
eligibility_criteria: Early-stage tech startups (pre-seed to Series A) affiliated with approved accelerator or VC partners (e.g. YC, Techstars)
Must have a live product, functional prototype, or verifiable engineering roadmap
Must use a company-domain email address
Independent / bootstrapped startups without partner codes should apply via Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub for Azure OpenAI access
required_documents: Partner accelerator / investor confirmation or invitation code
Company website and technical architecture outline
step_by_step_application: 1. Apply through your affiliated venture capital fund, accelerator partner, or Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub.
2. If applying through an approved VC/accelerator, obtain the partner-exclusive OpenAI claim link or redemption code.
3. If applying bootstrapped without a partner VC, navigate to startups.microsoft.com to unlock up to $150,000 in Azure OpenAI Service sponsorship credits.
4. Sign in to your organization dashboard at platform.openai.com (or Azure Portal).
5. Apply credit voucher to your billing settings and generate API keys for GPT-4o and reasoning models.
6. Monitor usage through organization usage limits and tier progression.
perk_metadata.anti_hallucination_notes: OpenAI does NOT offer a direct public self-serve application form for non-backed startups. Beware of scams claiming free $2,500 OpenAI vouchers on unverified forms. Independent startups should use Microsoft Founders Hub for verified Azure OpenAI credits.
